name: User Discovery - whoami
description:
Identify the current user account and security context using whoami. Adversaries use this command during initial
reconnaissance after gaining access to a system to determine the user and privilege level they are operating under.

mapping_evidence.note: Windows gap found in Phase 3: original execution MISSED under healthy Sysmon telemetry (only generic stock 92032/92052 fired, which also fire on benign cmd.exe /C children). JISRSEC rule(s) deployed 2026-11-03 20:06 UTC. Offline wazuh-logtest replay cannot emulate eventchannel decoding, so validation is LIVE: retest DETECTED and benign negative controls JISRSEC-CTRL-WIN-001/002 TN (e5d04bd6, 4552027a, re-run after the engine fix 44cdf5cd, d6fc4ce9).
